templates.label: Total population
templates.description: Total population for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series SP.POP.TOTL). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.

templates.label: Agriculture, forestry, fishing value-added (% of GDP)
templates.description: Agriculture, forestry, fishing value-added (% of GDP) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NV.AGR.TOTL.ZS). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.

templates.label: CO2 emissions per capita (excl. land use)
templates.description: CO2 emissions per capita (excl. land use) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series EN.GHG.CO2.PC.CE.AR5). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.

templates.label: CO2 emissions, total (excl. land use)
templates.description: CO2 emissions, total (excl. land use) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series EN.GHG.CO2.MT.CE.AR5). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.

templates.label: Industry (incl. construction) value-added (% of GDP)
templates.description: Industry (incl. construction) value-added (% of GDP) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.

templates.label: Manufacturing value-added (% of GDP)
templates.description: Manufacturing value-added (% of GDP) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NV.IND.MANF.ZS). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: Services value-added (% of GDP)
templates.description: Services value-added (% of GDP) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NV.SRV.TOTL.ZS). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: real GDP
templates.description: the selected country real GDP, constant 2015 USD (World Bank, NY.GDP.MKTP.KD, AUS). Annual, the most recent value is carried forward to the current date; World Bank data typically lags by about a year. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: real-GDP share of world
templates.description: the selected country real GDP / world real GDP (constant 2015 USD), annual (World Bank). the most recent value is carried forward to the current date; World Bank data typically lags by about a year. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: equity market vs. world
templates.description: iShares MSCI the selected country ETF (EWA) divided by Vanguard Total World ETF (VT), indexed to 100 at series start. Daily.

templates.label: GDP (current USD)
templates.description: GDP (current USD) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NY.GDP.MKTP.CD). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: GDP per capita (current USD)
templates.description: GDP per capita (current USD) for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series NY.GDP.PCAP.CD). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary. (GDP = Gross Domestic Product.)

templates.label: Life expectancy at birth
templates.description: Life expectancy at birth for the selected country, annual. From World Bank World Development Indicators (series SP.DYN.LE00.IN). Most regions and country aggregates available back to 1960; individual series start dates vary.
